definitions.explanation: bargain sale; selling at a discount; cheap sale

examples.japanese: このスーパーは{野菜|やさい}を{安売|やすう}りしている。
examples.english: This supermarket sells vegetables at a discount.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}セールで{全品|ぜんぴん}{安売|やすう}り{中|ちゅう}です。
examples.english: All items are on sale as part of the closing sale.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}を{下|さ}げずに{安売|やすう}りするのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to sell at a discount without lowering quality.

notes:
{安売|やすう}り combines {安|やす}い (cheap) with {売|う}り (selling), meaning to sell at reduced prices.

Common expressions:
- {安売|やすう}りする (to sell at a discount)
- {安売|やすう}り{中|ちゅう} (currently on sale)
- {安売|やすう}り{店|てん} (discount store)

Figurative usage:
- {自分|じぶん}を{安売|やすう}りする (to sell oneself short, to undervalue oneself)

Related terms:
- セール (sale)
- {特売|とくばい} (special sale)
- バーゲン (bargain sale)
